title: HelperSessionResizeParams
description: Params of the helper session service's resize op. The size is a property of the PTY and the PTY is the helper's, so this is not a lifecycle verb and carries no attachment: any attached caller may state the size it is rendering at. It is keyed by the durable session handle, like every other op that names a session.

xpixel.description: The client's cell metric in TIOCSWINSZ's own units: the WHOLE text area's width in pixels (cols × cell width). 0 means the client has not measured itself yet. The helper decodes it into the per-cell metric the runtime commits, at exactly one boundary (nocx-zg3k3.2.9).

ypixel.description: The whole text area's height in pixels (rows × cell height), or 0 when unmeasured. Same decode rule as xpixel.
